edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: NCL are characterised by seizures, loss of vision, and progressive motor and cognitive decline, and are the most common form of childhood dementia.

edges.subject: Batten disease
edges.object: sex differences in severity and progression
